params.name: path
params.description: Text or Text array containing one or more method path(s)

params.name: option
params.description: 0 or omitted = simple export (without tokens), 1 = export with tokens
If passed, applies to the host database's methods when called from a component (otherwise ignored).

constraints: path and code must be the same kind (both Text, or both Text array); the two syntaxes cannot be mixed.

option selects the export mode for tokenized language elements: 0 or omitted exports code as displayed in the Method editor (no tokens); 1 (or the Code with tokens constant) exports each tokenized element (4D commands/constants, table/field names, plug-in commands) followed by its internal token reference, making the code independent of subsequent renaming or language changes.
